build_pipeline_with_merge: build a pipeline that merges outputs from two sub-pipelines using Merge and PipelineConfig
build_pipeline_with_processed_merge: build a pipeline that merges outputs from sub-pipelines each with their own Pipe transformations
build_pipeline_with_post_processing: build a pipeline that merges multiple sub-pipelines and applies post-processing Pipe after the merge
build_pipeline_with_custom_merge_op: build a pipeline using Merge with a custom async merge operation to prefix items by source pipeline
build_pipeline_with_concurrent_merge: build a pipeline that merges sub-pipelines with concurrent Pipe processing and larger buffer sizes
